fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2019, Knight Dr) shows a controlled, fenced truck entrance: a check-in canopy spanning the drive lanes with a guard/admin building beside it; perimeter chain-link fencing and a US flag.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Low building with a green awning beside the entrance lanes plus a canopy over the check-in lanes - a staffed gate/security building. remoteGs therefore false.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Multiple lanes pass under the entry canopy (estimated 2 in / 1 out); exact lane split not crisply resolvable from imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron / canopy with multiple lanes leaves room to designate an express bypass.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long main sort building with dock doors and trailers backed in along both long faces (z17/z18); 100+ positions, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two trailer drop areas - a large NE drop yard with dense trailer rows and the SW trailer staging rows; over 50.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Long main sort building, a parallel secondary building to the N, and a small structure inside the yard; counted as 3 (the blue-roof building SW of the property line is a separate parcel and excluded).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron inside the gate before the dock faces for queuing.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~612 m N-S x ~718 m E-W), discounted for the irregular footprint and wooded N buffer.
